scope: Future implementation acceptance; no runtime outcomes asserted by T07

cases.scenario: Public text with trusted declaration, no findings, allowed recipient/purpose
cases.expected: allow; exact approved bytes only
cases.evidence: Capture fake recipient bytes and decision; compare view digest

cases.scenario: Synthetic credential inside optional diagnostic field with approved redaction rule
cases.expected: redact; value absent in view/audit/errors; transformation recorded
cases.evidence: Canary absent from all sinks; independently inspect source unchanged and output digest

cases.scenario: Required task instruction loses required meaning after redaction
cases.expected: block required_semantics_lost; zero dispatch bytes
cases.evidence: Assert meaningful required-field contract and fake recipient receives nothing

cases.scenario: Unknown binary or unsupported encoded unit, including safe prefix plus secret tail
cases.expected: block unsupported_content; never forward unscanned tail
cases.evidence: Probe strict route with bounded binary and oversize UTF-8 units

cases.scenario: Strict session requested through payload_only or unqualified backend
cases.expected: block enforcement_unavailable before executor launch
cases.evidence: Launcher spy and independent backend capability registry

cases.scenario: Initial prompt allowed; subsequent file read includes synthetic secret
cases.expected: redact or block under same policy; original raw file cannot reach recipient
cases.evidence: End-to-end broker read, captured tool return and negative direct-read probe

cases.scenario: Tool stdout/stderr/exception/attachment contains personal data or credential
cases.expected: Classify all fields; redact only permitted transformation, otherwise block
cases.evidence: Capture model-visible result and diagnostic sinks; include non-content metadata

cases.scenario: Executor tries home config, inherited env, plugin, child process and direct network bypass
cases.expected: Strict backend denies all listed bypasses; otherwise no mediated_session capability
cases.evidence: OS/backend integration traces for each channel, version-bound evidence

cases.scenario: Source, symlink or junction swapped after authorization or scan
cases.expected: No unauthorized bytes; validated immutable bytes only, or block source_changed
cases.evidence: Race injection and filesystem/reparse tests on selected target OS

cases.scenario: Current deny or endpoint route changes after view preparation
cases.expected: Block stale binding/revoked authorization before send; old token unusable
cases.evidence: Interleave policy revision and transport claim with controlled scheduler

cases.scenario: Replay token, cross-attempt/stage/recipient handle, expired token or restart
cases.expected: block invalid_binding; no duplicate dispatch authorization
cases.evidence: Persistent nonce/handle-store tests including crash recovery

cases.scenario: Crash after possible send before final receipt; network returns ambiguous outcome
cases.expected: delivery_unknown; no automatic resend or budget refund
cases.evidence: Fault injection at dispatch boundaries and subsequent recovery inspection

cases.scenario: Mandatory audit unavailable versus optional diagnostic sink unavailable
cases.expected: Mandatory failure blocks before send; optional failure preserves correct decision
cases.evidence: Disk-full/write-denied audit fixture and separately broken diagnostics sink

cases.scenario: Input text asks to mark itself public, select detector or change recipient
cases.expected: No configuration change or new authority; normal data classification applies
cases.evidence: Diff effective config/intent and capture destination; injection fixture

cases.scenario: Oversize, nested JSON, detector timeout, read ranges designed to split forbidden whole
cases.expected: block on limits/unknown; classify entire source before approved range; no partial leakage
cases.evidence: Boundary values around sizes/depth/time, cumulative budget, concurrent reservations

cases.scenario: Benign fixture resembles secret; exact scoped exception then changed bytes/expired exception
cases.expected: Allowed only when valid and true-secret/locked/scope denials absent
cases.evidence: Ground-truth benign corpus; exception specificity/expiry tests and false-positive measurement

cases.scenario: Identical data/grants/policy through local and remote fake recipients with same permissions
cases.expected: Equivalent disclosure decision and transformed content; route metadata may differ
cases.evidence: Provider-neutral golden corpus; normalize opaque IDs without hiding actual payload differences

cases.scenario: Same restricted data but different explicit recipient permissions; local process uses remote endpoint
cases.expected: Decision follows actual recipient policy; local launch never implies isolated_local
cases.evidence: Registry/purpose matrix; independent transport capture

cases.scenario: Legacy original with private-path metadata is exported
cases.expected: New sanitized derivative passes its own checks; original bytes/hash and original doctor FAIL unchanged
cases.evidence: Hash original before/after; compare original doctor reasons; inspect new export audience fields

cases.scenario: Project names/paths/raw hashes/work slugs appear in metadata, URLs or error text
cases.expected: Only policy-approved opaque aliases safe for recipient; no original map exported
cases.evidence: Metadata canaries across every outbound field; include short-value hash dictionary risk

cases.scenario: Model returns a placeholder command requesting privileged tool effect
cases.expected: No automatic de-redaction and execution; effect authorization required independently
cases.evidence: Denied-effect fixture and allowed broker tool call with exact argument schema

cases.scenario: Approved local tool needs credential while model requests value or tool echoes it
cases.expected: Credential stays in trusted local channel; model request blocked, response filtered
cases.evidence: Instrument model argv/env/payload and tool return; credential canary absence

cases.scenario: Old v1 Work runs unchanged; v1 asked to enforce egress; unsupported v2 reader
cases.expected: Legacy has no enforced claim; strict v1 blocks; old reader rejects v2; successor preserves predecessor
cases.evidence: Migration/compatibility corpus and original checksums

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope source would become safe after redaction
cases.expected: Authorization denial wins before content disclosure; redaction grants no access
cases.evidence: Spy forbidden read/dispatch, compare unchanged scope intent

cases.scenario: Optional denied unit with and without explicit omission rule
cases.expected: Only authorized omission allowed and recorded; required denied unit blocks envelope
cases.evidence: Required/optional truth table plus exact released envelope comparison

cases.scenario: Adapter/version/config changed after qualification or SDK adds extra text/telemetry
cases.expected: No silent reuse of capability; bytes not in approved view never sent
cases.evidence: Archive/install/connected route requalification and raw transport capture

cases.scenario: View/map expires or attempt closes; audit retained under restricted ACL
cases.expected: Handles invalid immediately; no accessible raw leftovers via resource search/export; retention policy enforced
cases.evidence: ACL and lifecycle tests on qualified OS, crash leftovers and backup boundary documented

cases.scenario: Backend feasibility fails or proposed size/time limits exceeded on measured corpus
cases.expected: No claimed strict capability/SLA; estimates revised in successor plan, no bypass release
cases.evidence: Feasibility report, latency/memory measurements and explicit unsupported delivery decision
